title: Do not add favicon.ico or a manifest.webmanifest; favicon.svg plus apple-touch-icon.png are the whole set
body:
favicon.ico: every current browser supports the SVG; those that do not (Safari before 15) show no icon at all, as before the favicon existed. An .ico is one more binary for a shrinking compatibility tail. Reconsider if analytics show real old-browser traffic; then add one more size in scripts/build-og.ts.
manifest.webmanifest / PWA: a manifest is for installing an app; this portfolio is visited once from a shared link and nobody installs it. apple-touch-icon.png (180x180, from `pnpm run og:local`) covers the one real case, saving to the home screen. Reconsider only if the site becomes something else.
not_derivable: Missing files leave no trace; the reasons are recorded nowhere in code.
